name: Hang Power Clean
description: The hang power clean combines the starting position of the hang clean with the above-parallel catch of the power clean. The athlete begins from the hip or knee hang position and receives the bar above parallel, requiring both high bar speed from the hip drive and a quick partial drop under the bar. It is widely used in sport conditioning as a power development tool and requires less front rack mobility than the full clean.

execution.starting_position: Bar at hip height, shoulder-width clean grip, hips hinged, flat back.
execution.setup_instructions: Same setup as hang clean. Use bumper plates.
steps: Step 1: Hold bar at hip height in hang position.
Step 2: Drive hips forward explosively with full extension.
Step 3: Shrug and pull elbows high.
Step 4: Quickly rotate elbows under and catch in front rack above parallel (quarter squat).
Step 5: Stand fully and lower the bar to the hang or floor.
execution.breathing_instructions: Brace before pull. Exhale after standing from the catch.
common_mistakes: Using arm strength rather than hip drive
Collapsing the front rack on catch
safety_considerations: Use bumper plates. Practice the hip drive and high pull separately first.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full hip extension. Above-parallel catch with locked elbows in front rack.
execution.tempo_recommendations: Explosive drive. Quick catch. Controlled stand.
coaching_cues: Hips fully open before elbows turn
